name: bestsaaswebdesigns
description: Search a curated catalog of 400+ real SaaS marketing websites by category, page section, visual style, tech stack, colour and font. Results include each site's homepage link, categories, style, stack, colour palette, fonts and captured sections.

interface.longDescription:
BestSaaSWebDesigns is a curated catalog of 400+ real SaaS marketing websites. Use it when you design or build a landing page and want real references instead of guesses.

What it can do:
- Find sites by product category (AI, developer tools, fintech, security and more), page section (hero, pricing, testimonials, FAQ, footer and more), visual style (dark, light, colorful, minimal), tech stack (Next.js, Webflow, Framer and more), font, or a hex colour close to their palette.
- Return each site's homepage link, categories, style, stack, five-colour palette, display and body fonts, and which sections were captured.
- Give a batch of homepage links so you can open the live sites and study the current design yourself.

Who it's for: designers, founders and developers building SaaS marketing sites, and the AI agents helping them.

Limitations: read-only; it returns links and design data, not screenshots or images. It covers only the sites in the catalog, which grows every week. It never visits or fetches the websites itself.
capabilities: Search SaaS websites by category, section, style, stack, font or colour
Colour palettes and fonts for each site
Homepage links to open live sites
defaultPrompt: Find 5 dark SaaS pricing pages and compare their colour palettes.
Which SaaS sites use Inter as their display font? Give me their website links.
Show me minimal AI product sites with a hero section and list their fonts.

positive.prompt: What categories, page sections and styles can I search on BestSaaSWebDesigns?
positive.expected_behavior: Lists the categories, section types, styles and tech stacks with how many sites match each.

positive.prompt: Find 5 dark SaaS sites that have a pricing page and show their colour palettes.
positive.expected_behavior: Returns up to 5 dark-style sites with a captured pricing section, each with its website link and hex colour palette.

positive.prompt: Which SaaS websites have a colour palette close to #5e6ad2?
positive.expected_behavior: Returns sites whose palette contains a colour near #5e6ad2, nearest first, with their palettes and website links.

positive.prompt: Tell me about Linear's website design: its fonts, colours and stack.
positive.expected_behavior: Returns Linear's website link, fonts (display, and body when detected), colour palette, tech stack, categories and captured sections.

positive.prompt: Give me 10 homepage links of AI product websites so I can look at them.
positive.expected_behavior: Returns up to 10 AI-category sites as names with their homepage links only.

negative.prompt: Book me a flight to Lisbon next Friday.
Open my Figma file and change the button colour to blue.
How do I reverse a linked list in Python?

review.commerce_description: This plugin does not sell products or process payments.

publication.release_notes: Initial release: search 400+ real SaaS marketing websites by category, section, style, stack, colour and font, and get homepage links, palettes and fonts.
